# externs-phpstubs

> Read-only Kotlin registry for PHP built-in function, class, method, and constant metadata with dataflow summaries.

`PhpStubs` is the singleton entry point. All input names normalized: strip leading `/` and `\`, then lowercase.

## Instructions for Agents

- Call `PhpStubs.searchFunc(name)` for `StubRecord.Function?`, `searchClass(name)` for `StubRecord.PhpClass?`.
- Call `PhpStubs.searchMethod(methodName, className?)` for `Pair<String, StubRecord.Method>?`.
- Call `PhpStubs.searchGlobalConst(name)` for `StubRecord.Constant?`, `searchClassConst(constName, className?)` for `StubRecord.ClassConstant?`.
- `StubRecord` is a sealed class with 6 subtypes: `Function`, `Method`, `PhpClass`, `Constant`, `ClassConstant`, `Property`.
- `normalize()` strips both `/` and `\` prefix. Pass names with or without leading slash.
- `flowsToReturn` empty = pure function. Return does not contain parameter data.
- Taint rules (source/sink/sanitizer) are NOT in this library.

## API Reference

- [Stubs API](llms/stubs.md): `PhpStubs`, `StubRecord`, `StubParam`, `PhpType`, `Visibility`.
